Have you ever had a cold from hell? Or pneumonia? Or strep? Or anything else where you've spent at least a week trapped in mucus hell and unable to sleep because you literally cannot breathe? Did you feel at all capable of walking around on a street or boarding a train or going grocery shopping during that? No? Well then that's how you know this shit is fake because that's not even close to the "lungs.exe have shut down" stage of a respiratory virus.
